name: Surgical Aid Society
title: Surgical Aid Society
---

The Royal Surgical Aid Society was founded in 1862 to provide the poor with artificial limbs, trusses, ear trumpets, leg irons and boots.

With the institution of the NHS it began to run old people’s homes, and is now called AgeCare, see www.agecare.org.uk
